label: SAMPLE eval: the 12 sample asks × the 3 presets. Expected verdicts are the hand-written literal reading in lib/sample, the same reading the gate rubric was written next to, so this set is not held out.
author: Alan Arguello
author_note: (hand-written SAMPLE expectations, ported from the prototype’s data.js)

cases.rules:
Happy to talk to founders about churn, activation or support load.
Only if they have real usage: a customer count, a churn rate or a ticket count.
No fundraising asks.
No asks to review a deck.

ask.text: Customers churn after month 3: 31 of 120 accounts left last quarter, most right after onboarding ends. Tried a check-in call at day 60 and an annual discount; no change. Need 20 minutes with someone who has cut early churn in a B2B product, before Nov 21. Offer: our cancellation interview notes.
